sentences.0-1: In Taipei, 9 out of 10 buildings are over 30 years old.
sentences.0-2: When an earthquake hits, who do we help first?
sentences.1-1: We combined five factors: older residents, old buildings, liquefaction, narrow lanes, and soft stories, to rank 456 villages for safety checks.
sentences.1-2: Change the weights, and you can see the ranking move.
sentences.2-1: In this village, 8 in every 100 people are over 80, and fire trucks cannot get into 9 narrow lanes.
sentences.2-2: With this sheet, the village chief knows what to drill first.
sentences.3-1: Enter your address to see what your home is worth now, and what you would get back.
sentences.3-2: For the same unit, new-home prices show a gain of NT$5.39 million; real renewal cases show a loss of NT$4.29 million.
sentences.3-3: Whether it pays depends on which price you trust.
sentences.4-1: Extra floor area is stacked up, one block at a time.
sentences.4-2: Tap a block to see why, and which law allows it.
sentences.4-3: Across Taipei, the most common bonuses are good design and space for sidewalks.
sentences.5-1: Everyone sees one board showing which consent forms are in.
sentences.5-2: How many are missing, who needs a registered letter, and when consent can be withdrawn, all at a glance.
sentences.6-1: Out of 100 old apartment buildings, only 13 get everyone to agree the way things work now.
sentences.6-2: Explain the payback clearly and assign a case manager, and it can reach 45.
sentences.7-1: Urban renewal passes 8 stations across 4 departments. From filing to approval alone, the median is 2.7 years.
sentences.7-2: We drew it as a metro map: who is in charge at each station, and how long it takes.
sentences.8-1: After renewal, the roof does not have to be sheet metal.
sentences.8-2: Drag to pick the look you like and give it a like. Design starts with residents.
sentences.9-1: Six tools, one set of open data.
sentences.9-2: Resident, village chief, or city staff? Pick one, and we will plan your route.
sentences.1-3: The 32 villages with the most old buildings hold 6% of homes, yet get only 1.7% of the rebuild and renewal cases.
sentences.2-3: Where to shelter, and how far each narrow lane is from a fire hydrant, are on the sheet too.
sentences.3-4: You can also see the village's average income, and whether the cost is affordable.
